description.narrative: (USAID Bureau for Inclusive Growth, Partnerships, and Innovation (IPI)): .The Innovation, Technology & Research Hub's Technology Division (ITR/T) established the Digital Forward Activity to build the capacity of USAID Missions, Washington Operating Units (OUs), and partners to advance digital initiatives that enhance security and economic prosperity in partner countries while safeguarding individual rights, freedom of expression, and democratic norms and practices. Digital Forward advances the research, training, strategic thinking, digital-sector partnerships, and behavior change that will equip USAID for the digital age. Digital Forward fosters the effective and responsible use of digital technology across all technical and regional sectors, and supports the growth of open, inclusive, and secure digital ecosystems in partner countries.
